features.title: Knows when you took over
features.text: Recall learns the state the automation ends up in. Dimmed the light, moved the blind or turned up the heating since? recall.restore leaves it alone.

features.title: Named slots
features.text: Two automations on the same device no longer overwrite each other. Slots even hand over to each other in any order.

features.title: Survives restarts
features.text: Stored in .storage/recall.snapshots, not in the attributes of an entity.

features.title: Restores like a scene
features.text: Home Assistant's own reproduce_state brings back position and tilt, brightness and colour, climate targets and more. Optional light transition.

features.title: Expiry
features.text: expires_after forgets a remembered state that was never restored, set per action or as a default.

features.title: Answers and events
features.text: Every action returns what it did: restored, or skipped with a reason. Events for everything, plus the condition recall.is_saved.

entities.title: recall.save
entities.text: Remember entities, devices, areas, floors or labels in a slot, with optional expiry, overwrite and tolerance.

entities.title: recall.restore
entities.text: Put the slot back. Skips what was changed by hand, forgets afterwards, optional transition for lights.

entities.title: recall.forget
entities.text: Drop a whole slot or single entities without moving anything.

entities.title: Condition recall.is_saved
entities.text: True when every target is remembered in the slot, optionally only if nobody changed it.

entities.title: Sensor
entities.text: sensor.recall_saved_states counts remembered entities. The slots attribute shows saved, expected and changed by.

entities.title: Options
entities.text: Default settings for restoring, detecting manual changes and expiry, plus a list of remembered states to forget.

items.title: 1. Remember
items.text: recall.save stores the current state and registers the automation run that called it.

items.title: 2. Settle
items.text: Every change by that run restarts a quiet window. The calm state at the end is what the automation wanted.

items.title: 3. Restore or skip
items.text: Still as expected? Restore. Changed by someone else? Skip with the reason, or hand over to another slot.

title.name: Recall
title.lead: Remember a state. Restore it, unless you changed it.
title.sub: Lights for a movie, blinds for the sun, the thermostat while a window is open: Recall puts them back afterwards and leaves alone what was moved by hand.
